inventory.interpretation: The 186 aggregate observer frames are not 186 unique opaque class records. The source capture map contains 74 opaque carriers plus 112 standard-object frames. Bounded physical AC1021 routes qualify 25 typed VISUALSTYLE records plus their 25 extension dictionaries and 25 XRECORDs (50 standard frames), 17 rooted SCALE records, 12 rooted DICTIONARYVAR records, three MATERIAL records with their owner/extension dictionaries and seven XRECORDs (11 additional standard frames), and one DBCOLOR record with its ACAD_COLOR owner dictionary and source-bound ACAD APPID row (two additional standard frames). The MATERIAL and DBCOLOR slices check selected ASCII/Binary output, typed and source payload readback, atomic refusal and retry. The remaining 16 opaque carriers and 49 standard-object frames remain unqualified; source-byte capture or matching typed callbacks alone do not qualify serialization.
